lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately 10 vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (light grey) intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a recurring grid-like matrix across the dark primary flank coloration.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transitioning from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Reddish-brown pixel clusters indicating possible skin lesions or biofouling are visible on the dorsal midline anterior to the first dorsal fin and on the leading edge of the superior caudal lobe; a small notch is visible on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: There is a significant transition in spot morphology at the first gill slit, where small, high-density spots on the cephalic region shift to larger, lower-density spots in a grid arrangement on the body.
